name: freeinference-companion
description: FreeInference Companion plugin for Codex: local lifecycle recording, provider diagnostics, and model discovery. It never proxies inference traffic; Codex context and cache measurements remain unavailable. Community-built and unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FreeInference.

interface.shortDescription: Local Codex lifecycle recording and FreeInference diagnostics.
interface.longDescription: Community-built Codex plugin with local lifecycle hooks plus provider diagnostics, model discovery, and configuration guidance. Hook handlers record bounded session state locally and never proxy prompts or add inference requests. Codex context and cache metrics remain unavailable because Codex does not expose those live measurements to plugins.
defaultPrompt: Check FreeInference service status and provider configuration.
